**Finding: Compliant** (Rule WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration)

Section 19 sits at or above the preferred position:

- **Standard of performance** (19.1): professional and workmanlike, qualified personnel, industry standards, plus material conformance to documentation and specifications.
- **Duration** (19.2): 90 days for Deliverables measured from delivery *or acceptance, whichever is later*; Hosted Services warranted throughout the subscription term — better than the 90-day floor.
- **Additional warranties** (19.3): no malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminishment, no contaminating open-source.
- **Remedy** (19.4): re-perform/repair/replace at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid; expressly *not* exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security or indemnified claims.
- **Disclaimer** (19.5): limited to implied warranties and expressly subordinated to the express warranties, service levels, indemnities and other remedies — it does not swallow the express warranty.

Section 6 (Acceptance) supports this with a reject/correct cycle and refund right. No redline proposed.
